entities.summary: The University of Canterbury is a public research university based in Christchurch, New Zealand. It was founded in 1873 as Canterbury College, the first constituent college of the University of New Zealand. It is New Zealand's second-oldest university, after the University of Otago, which was founded four years earlier, in 1869. University of Canterbury is a nonprofit organization in Oceania, established in 1873. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
